listing.name: Daxter — daxter-recompiled (anthonyhfm)
listing.summary: This experimental alpha has a native Refract player. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe UCES00044 ISO. The project checks the executable SHA-256 and requires local decryption through PPSSPP.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On macOS, follow make macos-run to prepare, decrypt and recompile locally. Windows uses the MSVC, Qt6 and FFmpeg source build. PSP and PPSSPP targets are for development only.

warnings: This experimental alpha has a native Refract player. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
